text_blocks.snippet: Limb ataxia, in the context of the National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS), refers to the impaired coordination of limb movements, particularly when performing specific tasks like finger-to-nose or heel-to-shin tests. It's evaluated by assessing how well a person can perform these movements, with scores reflecting the degree of impairment relative to weakness.
